finn.definition: n. a native or inhabitant of Finland

finna.definition:
Abbreviation of "fixing to".  Normally means "going to".
> I'm finna go da' sto!

finnair.translation: abbr. Finish Airlines 芬兰的航线; Finnair Aero O/Y (=Finnish Airlines) 芬兰航空公司; Finnair O/Y 芬兰航空公司

finnan.definition: n haddock usually baked but sometimes broiled with lots of butter

finned.definition:
v equip (a car) with fins
v propel oneself through the water in a finning motion
v show the fins above the water while swimming

finnegans wake.translation: 芬尼根守灵夜（爱尔兰作家 James Joyce 写的小说）

finney.translation:
n. (Finney)人名；(瑞典)芬内；(英)芬尼
芬尼

finney's operation.translation: [医] 芬尼氏手术(胃十二指肠吻合术)

finnic.definition: n one of two branches of the Finno-Ugric languages; a family of languages including Finnish and Estonian (but not Hungarian)
finnic.translation: a. 芬兰人的, 芬兰语的

finnicky.translation: a. (=finicky)吹毛求疵的, 难以讨好的

finning.definition:
v equip (a car) with fins

n. the official language of Finland; belongs to the Baltic Finnic family of languages

n. 芬兰语

finno-ugrian.definition: n. a family of Uralic languages indigenous to Scandinavia and Hungary and Russia and western Siberia (prior to the Slavic expansion into those regions)

n. pl. Natives of Finland; Finlanders.
